description:
Toggle a journal entry's share flag.

Shared, evaluated entries appear under the patron's row on the
public Leaderboard for peer learning. Priced at 0 sats — the social
value of sharing is the point, not the revenue.

entry_id.description: UUID of the journal entry to toggle.

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

shared.description: True to share, False to unshare. Defaults to True.

name: optionality_share_entry
